name: Relentless lets Witchbane hit one more enemy and deal 30% more damage (#1956)
contract: Relentless 520593 has E0 aura 107 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER) MiscValue 17 (SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS), BasePoints 1 / DieSides 0 = +1, and E1 aura 108 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER) MiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE), BasePoints 29 / DieSides 1 = +30%, both with class mask (0, 0, 0x80000000); its description reads 'Increases the damage of Witchbane by $s2% and allows it to hit an additional nearby enemy'. Witchbane's triggered shot 704342 is SpellFamilyName 21, flags C 0x80000000, ChainTarget 1 for effect 0; the channel ranks (800165 ... 574320) carry B 0x400000 only and are the controls. SpellInfo/Spell chain targeting adds SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS to the chain count (1 -> 2) and SPELLMOD_DAMAGE scales the damage (1000 -> 1300). The chain count is asserted as the native modifier value; the actual extra hit needs a positioned second enemy and is not exercised here.
